quests.desc: You are now playing a life changing game of TextWorld! First off, move east. With that done, head south. Then, take a trip west. And then, attempt to go to the south. Then, take a trip east. Then, make an effort to go east. And then, recover the cloak from the floor of the pantry. And once you've done that, you win!
